nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template for the apps/web Vite frontend, documenting VITE_POSTHOG_KEY for PostHog analytics and the optional VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY for Clerk auth — both baked into the Tauri binary at compile time.
nodes.languageNotes: Both keys are VITE_ prefixed so Vite exposes them to the client bundle; the Clerk key is intentionally left blank/commented so a verbatim copy degrades gracefully to the accountless state rather than crashing.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui CLI configuration for the apps/web frontend, specifying the default style, Tailwind CSS integration with cssVariables, and import path aliases for components, utils, ui, lib, and hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: The rsc:false setting disables React Server Components, consistent with the Vite SPA (non-Next.js) setup; tsx:true means shadcn generates .tsx files.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite SPA entry HTML for Waggle OS, mounting the React app at #root with Open Graph metadata and loading /src/main.tsx as the module entry point.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @waggle/web frontend workspace, declaring dev scripts (vite, vitest, playwright), a comprehensive Radix UI + React 19 + Clerk + TanStack Query dependency set, and Tailwind 3 + Vite 5 build toolchain.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses React 19 with the SWC Vite plugin for fast compilation; notable dependencies include @clerk/clerk-react for auth, @tauri-apps/api for desktop shell integration, framer-motion for animation, posthog-js for analytics, and the full Radix UI component suite underlying shadcn/ui.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the apps/web browser source (src/), targeting ES2020 with bundler module resolution, noEmit type-checking mode, and an @/* path alias for the src/ directory.
nodes.languageNotes: strict:false and noImplicitAny:false indicate a permissive type-checking stance for rapid iteration; vitest/globals is added to types to make test helpers available without imports.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript project references config for apps/web, composing tsconfig.app.json (browser source) and tsconfig.node.json (Vite config) into a single build project with shared @/* path alias.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TypeScript project references (composite build) to separate browser and Node environments; strictNullChecks:false is applied at the root level as a blanket override.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the Vite config file (vite.config.ts) in apps/web, targeting ES2022 with strict mode enabled and bundler module resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: This config is intentionally stricter (strict:true) than tsconfig.app.json because vite.config.ts runs in a Node.js context where type safety is more tractable; includes only vite.config.ts.
